name: Fusion Filaments
summary: Value-tier US filament seller based in Maryland Heights, Missouri, with a copolyester-heavy catalog (PCTG, HT-PET) alongside PLA, ABS and ASA and a government/school purchasing program. Whether it extrudes its own filament or sources it was not established from available pages.

product_lines.name: PLA (4043D)
product_lines.notes: Standard PLA on NatureWorks Ingeo 4043D, the common general-purpose extrusion grade. Includes the discounted 'Mystery' PLA at the bottom of the price range.

product_lines.name: HT-PLA (3D870) / HTPLA+
product_lines.notes: High-temperature PLA on NatureWorks Ingeo 3D870, a fast-crystallising annealable PLA resin — same chemistry family as Protopasta HTPLA, Push Plastic HH+T PLA and KVP P-PLA. HTPLA+ is the retail colourway name (Carbon Rod Black, Alpha Particle Orange). No dedicated high-heat-PLA id exists.

product_lines.name: HT-PET+ / PurePET
product_lines.notes: Marketed as high-temperature PET and positioned as distinct from standard PETG; the exact copolyester modification is undisclosed and no Tg/HDT figures are published, so neither petg nor pet can be asserted confidently.

product_lines.name: PCTG
product_lines.notes: Standard glycol-modified copolyester, higher impact and clarity than PETG.

product_lines.name: ABS (Matte / Gloss / Hi-Temp Matte)
product_lines.notes: Standard ABS with matte or gloss finish packages plus a higher-heat-grade variant.

product_lines.name: ASA / EasyASA / Hi-Temp ASA
product_lines.notes: Standard weatherable ASA plus an easier-printing formulation and a higher-heat grade.

additional_notes: Manufacturing location is not stated on the site; manufacturing_countries is set to the United States on the strength of the Missouri HQ and SAM.gov-registered government/school vendor positioning, which is inference rather than a documented claim. No OEM relationship was confirmed in either direction — neither an explicit in-house manufacturing claim nor any outsourcing arrangement was found — so oem_relationships is left empty. Pricing observed at $9.95/kg (PLA Mystery) up to $26.99/kg (PCTG) with $5 flat-rate shipping. The About Us page returned 404 on retry, so founding and history details are absent. No TPU, nylon, PC or fiber-filled lines confirmed.

provenance.conflicts: Manufacturing origin is unverified: the company does not state where its filament is extruded, and US origin is inferred from HQ and government-vendor status only. Corporate history is unavailable because the About page 404s.
